initial.name: terminal_close
initial.description: Close one persistent terminal and wait until its captured owned process tree is gone.

initial.name: terminal_list
initial.description: List persistent terminal sessions owned by the current agent.

initial.name: terminal_open
initial.description: Create a persistent, owner-isolated terminal session from a registered backend type. Use this for shell or REPL state that must survive across tool calls.

name.description: Optional owner-local display name such as "main" or "gdb".

cwd.description: Initial working directory. Defaults to the deployment workspace root.
